verdict.rationale: Pulley documents bulk loading of historical cap-table data: you can migrate your cap table from an Excel file built on Pulley's template, which it treats as the source of truth. Carta customers can instead have their reports imported directly with help from the onboarding team. This covers bulk upload of historical transactions at setup, but there is no evidence of batch-issuing new grants after onboarding. missing for 10: bulk issuance of new grants or securities (e.g., batch option grants with documents and signatures), self-serve bulk import beyond initial migration, details of the import format and validation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
